node.title: Re: Explicit Package?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Note that the program you showed is incomplete. It sets [doc://$^I], which is the equivalent of the [doc://perlrun|-i command-line switch] for in-place editing of files, it operates on the files in [doc://@ARGV], and is typically used via the magic [doc://perlop#I/O Operators|<> operator] ([id://1193548|example]). However, by writing <$in_fn> and print $out_fh, it seems you want to use explicit filehandles instead, and in that case, you need to explicitly [doc://open] those files, for example open my $out_fh, '>', $out or die "$out: $!";. If you do that, then don't also set $^I, as this may have unexpected effects in other parts of the program!
